title: ADX Environments
description: Select an Environment ID or narrow RE2 pattern for current inventory and fresh runtime usage. Detail queries are manual and start with no Environment selected.

list.name: environment_id
list.label: Environment ID regex (required)
list.description: Enter an Environment ID or narrow RE2 pattern. Use \x60 to match a backtick. Broad patterns explicitly request all matching instances.

panels.title: Environment Inventory

targets.expr: max by (cluster, adx_env, environment_id, node_id, state) (adx_environment_info{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",state=~"$state",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`})

panels.description: Select an Environment ID or narrow pattern first. Current Running/Paused logical inventory joined to fresh runtime samples. It is not a historical list of every created Environment. With all test Environments deleted, an empty inventory is expected; check scrape health to distinguish missing collection.

panels.title: Environment CPU Usage

targets.expr: rate(adx_environment_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`}[$__rate_interval]) and on (cluster, adx_env, instance, environment_id, runtime_id) (adx_environment_stats_age_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`} <= 45) and on (cluster, adx_env, environment_id) max by (cluster, adx_env, environment_id) (adx_environment_info{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",state=~"$state",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`})

panels.description: Select an Environment ID or narrow pattern first. Measured per-Environment CPU usage from fresh Running inventory and runtime observations. Requires at least two counter scrapes for a rate. No active Environment, no samples or stale observations produce no series.

panels.title: Environment Memory Usage

targets.expr: adx_environment_memory_usage_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`} and on (cluster, adx_env, instance, environment_id, runtime_id) (adx_environment_stats_age_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`} <= 45) and on (cluster, adx_env, environment_id) max by (cluster, adx_env, environment_id) (adx_environment_info{cluster=~"$cluster",adx_env=~"$adx_env",state=~"$state",environment_id=~`${environment_id:raw}`})

panels.description: Select an Environment ID or narrow pattern first. Measured memory for fresh Running Environments. Paused or deleted Environments do not display an old runtime sample as current memory. No active/fresh sample produces no series.

links.title: Environment Logs
links.tooltip: Open on-demand log search, initially the last 15 minutes.
